description: This file defines a PHP class implementing a TeraWurfl adapter for Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent features, including methods to load the TeraWurfl library, retrieve device capabilities from requests, and process capabilities data.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_TeraWurfl
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a TeraWurfl adapter for Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent features, capable of loading the TeraWurfl library, retrieving device capabilities from requests, and processing capabilities data.

methods.name: getFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves device features from an HTTP request using the TeraWurfl API, loading the TeraWurfl library if necessary based on configuration.

methods.name: getAllCapabilities
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of all device capabilities from the TeraWurfl object.
